jobs.description:
An organisation based in Zaventem operating within the property sector.

Jobomschrijving

As a Sales Support Specialist, you play a central role in ensuring a smooth and professional experience for our business partners and internal stakeholders.You act as a key coordination point between Sales, Finance, Operations, and our external partners, supporting the full lifecycle of sales-related requests.This role goes beyond pure administration. You work within structured procedures, but you also think proactively, communicate clearly, and help ensure that everything runs efficiently in a service-driven environment.What you will do

• Act as the main contact person for business partners and internal teams within the sales support scope
• Provide administrative and operational support to the sales team
• Register, process, and follow up on requests and applications through the full workflow, including validation with financial partners
• Manage customer and partner communication via email and web portal, ensuring speed, clarity, and professionalism
• Coordinate with internal departments such as Sales, Order Processing, Finance, and Operations
• Prepare and manage documents using structured templates and standardized procedures
• Monitor incoming and outgoing requests, documentation, and order statuses, and proactively resolve issues
• Ensure strict compliance with internal procedures and company policies, working in a detailed and precise manner
• Support the onboarding of new business partners, guiding them through tools, processes, and ways of working
• Maintain an overview of contracts, ongoing files, and partnership-related communication
• Contribute to continuous process improvement by identifying opportunities to optimize workflows and communication

What you bring to the table

• At least 2 years of experience in a sales support, administrative, or coordination role
• Experience in service-oriented environments such as banking, insurance, leasing, or similar sectors is a strong asset
• A structured and process-oriented mindset, with strong attention to detail
• Excellent organizational and multitasking skills
• Strong communication skills, with a customer- and partner-oriented approach
• Ability to work independently, while also thriving in a close-knit team where collaboration is key
• Languages: Very good knowledge of Dutch or French, with professional working knowledge of the other language
• English is a plus
• Comfortable working with Microsoft Office tools and web-based applications
• No advanced financial calculations required; a basic understanding of financial concepts is sufficient

Our client is an internationally renowned industrial organization and market leader in innovative technical solutions for customers across Europe, the Middle East and Africa. To support its continued growth and customer-centric strategy, the company is looking for a Customer Experience Representative to strengthen its EMEA Sales & Operations team.

Jobomschrijving

As a Customer Experience Representative, you will be the primary point of contact for a portfolio of B2B customers and play a key role in delivering an outstanding customer experience.Working closely with sales, operations, logistics and finance teams, you will ensure smooth order processing while proactively supporting commercial activities and continuous improvement initiatives.Customer Relationship Management

• Manage and follow up a dedicated portfolio of customers across the EMEA region.
• Act as the first point of contact for customer inquiries and service-related matters.
• Build strong customer relationships and ensure a high level of customer satisfaction.
• Handle customer claims, returns and complaints professionally and efficiently.
• Gather relevant customer and market feedback and share insights internally.
Order Management & Sales Support

• Manage the complete order-to-delivery process.
• Follow up on orders, backorders and delivery schedules.
• Prepare and follow up quotations in collaboration with the Account Managers.
• Provide customers with accurate information regarding pricing, lead times and product availability.
• Support the sales pipeline and contribute to achieving business targets.
• Monitor service performance and customer agreements.
Process Improvement & Operations

• Identify opportunities to improve customer service processes and operational efficiency.
• Collaborate closely with logistics and operations teams to optimize transport, packaging and order flows.
• Contribute to digitalization and continuous improvement initiatives.
• Ensure compliance with internal procedures and quality standards.
Financial Follow-up

• Support the monitoring of outstanding customer payments.
• Collaborate with finance teams regarding credit limits, payment conditions and invoice-related matters.

• Minimum 3 to 5 years of experience in Customer Service, Sales Support, Order Management or Inside Sales.
• Experience within an international B2B environment is a strong plus.
• Knowledge of ERP systems (SAP is an advantage).
• Fluent Dutch and English
• Proactive and able to work autonomously.

Your role: payroll expertise with room to grow 

Own the payroll essentials
  
• Coordinate Belgian payroll administration for approximately 30 employees, working with external payroll partners and ensuring timely, accurate input and follow-up. 
• Manage employee records, contracts, absences, benefits and personnel changes. 
• Act as a first point of contact for payroll and day-to-day HR questions. 
• Help maintain accurate HR reporting and compliance with Belgian employment requirements.  
Become involved in broader HR
  
• Coordinate onboarding and offboarding, ensuring new colleagues feel welcome and supported. 
• Contribute to employee benefits, mobility and cafeteria plan initiatives. 
• Help improve HR processes, procedures and employee-facing information. 
• Support recruitment coordination, training, engagement and other HR projects.  
You'll be trusted to take ownership of your work, while collaborating closely with experienced HR colleagues. The aim is to give you meaningful responsibility and the opportunity to keep learning—not to expect you to know every aspect of HR already.

Is this your next step? 
 
• Around three years or more of relevant experience in Belgian payroll and HR administration, including benefits. 
• Enough practical payroll knowledge to take ownership of day-to-day coordination quickly; SD Worx experience is a strong advantage. 
• Good knowledge of Belgian employment administration, confidence with Excel and an interest in HR systems. 
• Excellent English, Dutch at minimum B2 level with a B1 in French. French-speaking candidates with B2 Dutch and excellent English are equally welcome. 
• An organised, accurate, proactive and service-minded approach; you enjoy helping people and taking initiative. 
• A genuine interest in broadening your HR experience and building a lasting role in a collaborative team.  
A background in a law firm or consultancy, or a specific HR degree, is welcome but not required.

jobs.occupation: Group Internal Auditor - Brussels - Financial Services
jobs.description:
Our client is an established international financial services group headquartered in Brussels. Operating in a regulated and international environment, the organisation combines financial expertise with a strong focus on governance, risk management and internal control.To strengthen its Group Internal Audit department, we are currently looking for an experienced Group Internal Auditor.

Jobomschrijving

• Perform financial, operational and compliance audits across the Group
• Support the Group Chief Internal Auditor in defining and implementing the risk-based internal audit plan
• Independently manage complex audit assignments from scoping to final reporting
• Assess internal controls, governance and risk management frameworks, including IT/ICT-related risks
• Formulate clear and practical recommendations based on audit findings
• Present audit results to senior management and governance bodies
• Monitor the implementation of audit recommendations and action plans
• Coordinate audit follow-ups and contribute to the continuous improvement of the Internal Audit function

• Master's degree in Economics, Finance or another relevant field
• At least 7 years of relevant audit experience, ideally acquired within an international environment and/or a Big Four firm
• Strong knowledge of internal audit methodologies, risk-based auditing and internal control frameworks
• Previous exposure to IT/ICT audits is required
• Experience within Banking, Insurance or Financial Services is considered a strong asset
• A CIA, CISA or equivalent professional certification is considered an advantage
• Strong analytical capabilities with the ability to translate findings into practical and business-oriented recommendations
• Capable of managing complex audit assignments autonomously from start to finish
• Excellent stakeholder management skills and the ability to combine critical thinking with diplomacy and influence
• Proactive, structured and comfortable working independently within a compact audit team
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, combined with a good command of Dutch and/or French

jobs.description:
Our client is a leading international insurance company with a strong presence in the Belgian market. Through innovation, customer-centricity, and operational excellence, the organization continuously invests in transforming and growing their Business Units.To support the successful execution of its strategic ambitions, our client is currently looking for a Strategic Change Analyst to join its Brussels-based office.

Jobomschrijving

• Support the definition, structuring and monitoring of the Business Unit strategic roadmap
• Translate strategic priorities into compelling communication materials, executive presentations and impactful storytelling
• Prepare presentations, reports and strategic updates for senior management and executive committees
• Conduct business and strategic analyses to support decision-making and identify growth opportunities
• Perform ad hoc studies related to profitability, operational efficiency, organizational effectiveness and innovation
• Develop recommendations and action plans based on data-driven insights
• Contribute to the optimization and simplification of internal processes across the business unit
• Coordinate and monitor strategic initiatives, transformation projects and change management activities
• Support the annual budgeting process and oversee the monitoring of business unit operating expenses
• Prepare financial analyses, budget forecasts and management reporting
• Collaborate closely with Finance teams on cost allocation, financial planning and performance monitoring
• Act as a key liaison between business stakeholders and Finance to ensure alignment on financial objectives and priorities
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives within budgeting, reporting and governance processes

• Master's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Insurance or a related field
• Minimum 5 years of professional experience in strategy, consulting, business analysis, project management, transformation or change management
• Strong understanding of the Life Insurance sector, including products, regulations and market dynamics
• Experience supporting strategic planning, business transformation and roadmap execution
• Excellent analytical skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable recommendations
• Strong financial acumen with experience in budgeting, financial analysis and management reporting
• Proven ability to create impactful presentations and deliver effective executive-level storytelling
• Experience in process improvement and cross-functional project coordination
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills across multiple business functions
• Highly organized, autonomous and capable of challenging assumptions in a constructive manner
• Ability to synthesize complex information and present clear conclusions to management
• Fluency in French/Dutch and English, both written and spoken.

An international company based in Zaventem is looking for a (Junior) Accountant to join its Corporate Finance & Accounting team. In this role, you will support a wide range of accounting activities, contribute to monthly closing and reporting processes, and assist with audits. You will work closely with colleagues across different departments in an international environment.

Your responsibilities:

• You support internal departments with accounting-related questions, SAP bookings and invoice processing.
• You monitor invoice workflows in DMS and follow up on outstanding items.
• You process general expense invoices, bank bookings and employee expense claims in SAP.
• You support monthly closing, reporting, reconciliations and account checks.
• You follow up on open items, overdue payments and account discrepancies.
• You prepare audit documentation and support J-SOX requirements, fixed asset checks and stock counts.
• You update accounting procedures and contribute to process improvements.
• You provide back-up support for payments, banking, reporting and other accounting tasks.

Your profile:

• You have a bachelor's degree in Accounting or a related field.
• You are a motivated recent graduate or a junior accountant with some initial work experience.
• You have a good understanding of accounting principles and feel comfortable working with figures.
• You are confident using SAP and MS Office.
• You work accurately and in a structured way and have a proactive, solution-oriented mindset.
• You communicate effectively with different stakeholders and are a strong team player.
• You are fluent in English and have a good knowledge of French and Dutch.

jobs.description:

Jobomschrijving

In this role you will be handling the A-Z accounting tasks, including the following:

• General accounting tasks
• Performing monthly, quarterly, and year-end closings
• Review and control of the balance sheet
• Preparation and filing of the annual accounts (NBB)
• Submission of periodic VAT returns
• Preparation of corporate income tax
• Point of contact for audit matters
• Monthly financial reporting
• Process optimization and automation

We are looking for someone that matches the following criteria:

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting
• Minimum of 5 years experience in general accounting
• Strong knowledge of BE GAAP
• Fluent in Dutch and/or French, good command in English
• Excellent command of Excel
• Analytical mindset
• Team player with good communication skills
